ROOT CAUSE is a pin skew between two staged members, not a code defect: the source map stages served.py at 74a62fb46ce9 and interactive_access.py at 80a79a746284. At 74a62fb46ce9 interactive_access.py carries profile_reader 7 times; at 80a79a746284 it carries 0, and served.py at 80a79a746284 carries no such call. So 74a62fb46ce9 is a coherent pair and the two halves were simply staged from different commits. WHAT THIS ARM IS WORTH: unapplied, this would have been a second runtime TypeError on the CREATE_INPUT path, the same failure class as rev 4 -- which passed its own acceptance because it had no arm of this kind. The fix is one pin, routed to the issuer.
